title: SEVAL Query Set v1 (TSV)
description: Upload format: TSV file (matches SEVAL's QuerySet.fromTsv). The JSON Schema below describes the in-memory shape after CsvValidator converts each TSV row into a JSON object (the full file becomes a JSON array) — it is NOT the upload format. V1 query is a plain text utterance.

query.description: Plain text utterance (V1 query schema). Also accepted as column name 'utterance'.

segment.description: Segment classification (maps to 'segment' or 'segment 2' TSV column).

annotation.description: CIQ annotation JSON associated with the utterance, used to compose the Sydney request during scraping.

tags.description: Comma-separated feature tags (e.g., CIQ, FRE, Sparkle prompt).

pluginOptions.description: Meeting IDs information, required for meeting copilot.

plugins.description: Optional plugin configuration for Meeting Copilot.

locationInfo.description: User location JSON for MChat localization.

user_id.description: User email for per-query user override in MChat scraping.

chat_request_override.description: JSON string for extending new columns (e.g., clientContexts).

plugin_response_overrides.description: JSON string for adding plugin responses into scraping options.
